label: Long Voyage test: the phone game on the board, BLE sync (game firmware)
notes: Test build for the bench, not a stable release; nothing updates to it on its own. Needs the game firmware first: flash lv-core-0.1.0-f1b383588e79-RPI_PICO_W.uf2 by hand (hold BOOTSEL, drop the file on the RPI-RP2 drive); this page refuses to install on any other firmware. Then set the ship number in section 4, the crew codes and the launch date (flight day 1 starts at 06:00 that day and a new flight day every morning at 06:00, 42 days; leave it blank for the manual bench day), install, and power-cycle. Join the LV-<ship number> hotspot with a phone: the game opens by itself (or browse to any http address) and every crew member signs in with their code. BLE sync between ships keeps running. Check from the REPL with: import selftest; selftest.run(120). Your settings in data/ are kept. To go back, install 0.0.2-coex (it runs on the game firmware too).
